title: How Do You Register a Marriage Under the UCC?
desc: Marriage registration under Uttarakhand's UCC goes through the Sub-Registrar, costs Rs 250, and is usually decided within 15 days.
why: Over 4.74 lakh marriages have already been registered under Uttarakhand's Uniform Civil Code, and every couple marrying in the state still has to go through the same process to get a certificate.
keyPoints: Marriage registration under the UCC is handled by the Sub-Registrar, online or in person, not by the Family Court.
The standard fee is Rs 250, decided within 15 days; a tatkal option costs Rs 2,500 and is usually cleared in 3 days.
Couples need photographs, proof of age and residence, an officiant's certificate, and papers on any earlier marriage.
A marriage made before 27 January 2025 can usually be registered too, sometimes just needing an acknowledgement.

sections.h: How do you register a marriage under the Uttarakhand UCC?
p: Marriage registration under Uttarakhand's Uniform Civil Code is handled by the Designated Officer, acting through the Sub-Registrar of the area, either online on the UCC portal or in person. The standard fee is Rs 250, and the application must be decided within 15 days. An urgent, tatkal option costs Rs 2,500 and is usually cleared within 3 days.

This single process now applies to marriages across communities in the state, replacing the separate registration routes that used to exist under different personal laws. It does not apply to Scheduled Tribes, who are excluded from the Code.

sections.h: What documents and proof do you need?
p: Every application needs photographs of both spouses, a couple or wedding photo (the type depends on whether the marriage was before or after 27 January 2025), and a certificate from the person who conducted the marriage. If the couple already has a child, that child's birth or adoption certificate is also needed.

You must also show proof of age, such as a birth certificate, PAN card, passport or school certificate, and proof of residence, such as a domicile certificate, an employer's certificate, or a utility bill at least a year old. If either spouse was married before, papers such as a divorce decree or a former spouse's death certificate are required as well.

sections.h: Do older marriages also need to be registered?
p: Marriages solemnised before the Code took effect on 27 January 2025 can still be registered under it. Couples who already hold an earlier marriage registration do not need to apply afresh; government guidance says they only need to submit an acknowledgement of that existing registration.

News reports on the 2025 rules say newly solemnised marriages are expected to be registered within 60 days, and that a marriage does not become invalid only because it was not registered. For the exact wording of this deadline, check the UCC portal or the Act itself before relying on it for a specific case.

whatToDo: Apply on the UCC portal (ucc.uk.gov.in) or visit the Sub-Registrar's office for your area.
Keep scanned copies of both spouses' photographs, the officiant's certificate, and age and residence proof ready before applying.
If you married before 27 January 2025 and already have a registration certificate, check whether you only need to file an acknowledgement.
Track your application and certificate status on the portal using your reference number.

hi.title: यूसीसी के तहत विवाह पंजीकरण कैसे कराएं?
keyPoints: उत्तराखंड यूसीसी के तहत विवाह पंजीकरण सब-रजिस्ट्रार के माध्यम से होता है, न कि फैमिली कोर्ट में।
सामान्य शुल्क 250 रुपये है और आवेदन 15 दिन में तय होता है; तत्काल सेवा के लिए 2,500 रुपये लगते हैं और यह 3 दिन में पूरी होती है।
आवेदन के लिए दोनों पक्षों की फोटो, उम्र और निवास प्रमाण, तथा विवाह कराने वाले का प्रमाण पत्र चाहिए।
27 जनवरी 2025 से पहले हुई शादी भी पंजीकृत कराई जा सकती है, कई बार सिर्फ पुष्टिकरण देकर।
p: उत्तराखंड में अब तक 4.74 लाख से ज़्यादा विवाह यूसीसी के तहत पंजीकृत हो चुके हैं, और राज्य में विवाह करने वाले हर जोड़े को यही प्रक्रिया अपनानी होती है।
